title: Task list updates deferred to Phase 5 due to task ID loss after context compaction
description: Run 2aa600af-d3ac-46fa-9202-0780b1da8194: task IDs from create_task_list were not available after context compaction, preventing update_task calls at the end of each Phase 3 step. All four tasks were batch-updated during Phase 5. The task list did not serve as a live progress indicator during Phase 3.
proposed_resolution: Call get_run_status at the start of any post-compaction phase to recover task IDs before continuing implementation steps. The skill guidance should note this recovery pattern.
